# Pull request

## What does this PR do?

One or two sentences. Be specific.

## Type of change

- [ ] Fix (typo, broken link, single-line correction)
- [ ] Update (regulator change, framework revision, refreshed reference)
- [ ] New content (module section, scenario, template, reference table)
- [ ] Restructure or rename
- [ ] Other (explain below)

## Linked issue

Closes #_________ (if applicable). For substantive changes, an issue should exist before the PR.

## Citation or source (if changing facts)

Where the change updates a fact, deadline, control reference, or regulator process, link the authoritative source.

- Source: _________

## Pre-submission checklist

- [ ] Spelling is British English (organisation, recognised, behaviour).
- [ ] Voice matches the existing tone; no marketing language; no em-dashes.
- [ ] No emoji except the established persona markers (🟢 🟡 🔴) and resource-type legend (🏛 📘 📰 🎥 🧪 💰).
- [ ] New terms added to `reference/glossary.md` and `reference/acronyms.md` if relevant.
- [ ] Cross-references use relative links, not absolute URLs.
- [ ] External links are to authoritative sources, not marketing pages.
- [ ] Dates use `DD MonthName YYYY` format.
- [ ] I have read the section I am editing in full before changing it.
- [ ] No raw AI-generated text submitted; any AI-assisted drafting has been rewritten in my own voice.
- [ ] I have read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Anything reviewers should know

Optional: trade-offs you considered, alternatives you rejected, areas you would like specific feedback on.
